story.text: 오늘은 특별히 휴가를 냈습니다. 조종석 대신 공산성 금서루 앞에 서서, 누군가를 기다리고 있습니다.
story.reading: o-neul-eun teuk-byeol-hi hyu-ga-reul naet-seum-ni-da. jo-jong-seok dae-sin gong-san-seong geum-seo-ru ap-e seo-seo, nu-gu-ga-reul gi-da-ri-go it-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Today, I specially took the day off. Instead of the cockpit, I'm standing in front of Geumseoru Gate at Gongsanseong Fortress, waiting for someone.

story.text: 십 년 지기 친구와의 '재회'입니다. 비행 스케줄을 이렇게까지 여러 번 바꿔 본 적은 처음입니다.
story.reading: sip nyeon ji-gi chin-gu-wa-ui 'jae-hoe'-im-ni-da. bi-haeng seu-ke-jul-eul i-reo-ke-kka-ji yeo-reo beon ba-kkwo bon jeog-eun cheo-eum-im-ni-da.
story.en: It's a 'reunion' with a friend I've known for ten years. This is the first time I've rearranged my flight schedule this many times.

story.text: '오랜만'이라는 말이 이렇게 벅찰 줄은 몰랐습니다. 저만치 버스에서 낯익은 실루엣이 내렸습니다.
story.reading: 'o-raen-man'-i-ra-neun mal-i i-reo-ke beok-chal jul-eun mol-lat-seum-ni-da. jeo-man-chi beo-seu-e-seo nat-ig-eun sil-lu-et-i nae-ryeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: I never knew the words 'long time no see' could feel this overwhelming. Off in the distance, a familiar silhouette stepped off the bus.

story.text: "타워, 오랜만이다!" 저도 모르게 그 애칭이 먼저 튀어나왔습니다. 침착함을 유지하던 관제탑 기장도 결국 크게 손을 흔들고 말았습니다.
story.reading: "ta-wo, o-raen-man-i-da!" jeo-do mo-reu-ge geu ae-ching-i meon-jeo twi-eo-na-wat-seum-ni-da. chim-chak-ham-eul yu-ji-ha-deon gwan-je-tap gi-jang-do gyeol-guk keu-ge son-eul heun-deul-go mal-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "Tower, long time no see!" The old nickname slipped out before I even realized it. Even the captain who always kept his composure ended up waving his arm wide.

story.text: 타워는 오래전 제가 붙인 별명입니다. 이 친구 목소리를 들을 때마다, 관제사처럼 든든하다고 느꼈거든요.
story.reading: ta-wo-neun o-rae-jeon je-ga but-in byeol-myeong-im-ni-da. i chin-gu mok-so-ri-reul deul-eul ttae-ma-da, gwan-je-sa-cheo-reom deun-deun-ha-da-go neu-kkyeot-geo-deun-yo.
story.en: 'Tower' is a nickname I gave this friend a long time ago. Every time I hear their voice, it feels as reassuring as an air traffic controller's.

story.text: 짐을 받아 들고 근황과 '안부'를 묻는 사이, 우리는 어느새 나란히 성벽 길을 걷고 있었습니다.
story.reading: jim-eul bad-a deul-go geun-hwang-gwa 'an-bu'-reul mut-neun sa-i, u-ri-neun eo-neu-sae na-ran-hi seong-byeok gil-eul geot-go it-seot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: As I took their bag and we asked after each other's news, before we knew it, we were walking side by side along the fortress wall.

story.text: 말투는 여전히 격식 있게 나가지만, 사실 이렇게 '반갑'기는 정말 오랜만입니다.
story.reading: mal-tu-neun yeo-jeon-hi gyeok-sik it-ge na-ga-ji-man, sa-sil i-reo-ke 'ban-gap'-gi-neun jeong-mal o-raen-man-im-ni-da.
story.en: My tone still comes out formal as ever, but honestly, it's been a very long time since I've felt this 'glad' to see someone.

story.text: "많이 그리웠다." 딱 한마디, 낮은 목소리로 진심을 전했습니다. 관제탑 기장에게도, 이런 순간은 있습니다.
story.reading: "man-i geu-ri-wot-da." ttak han-ma-di, nat-eun mok-so-ri-ro jin-sim-eul jeon-haet-seum-ni-da. gwan-je-tap gi-jang-e-ge-do, i-reon sun-gan-eun it-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "I missed you a lot." Just one short line, said low and sincere. Even a control-tower captain has moments like this.

story.text: 성벽 위로 부는 바람이 유난히 시원하던 오후였습니다. 그날 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: seong-byeok wi-ro bu-neun ba-ram-i yu-nan-hi si-won-ha-deon o-hu-yeot-seum-ni-da. geu-nal na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: It was an afternoon when the wind atop the fortress wall felt especially refreshing. Let me share the conversation we had that day.

words.example_en: A reunion with an old friend is always moving.
Meeting after so long, we have a mountain of things to talk about.
I asked my friend how they'd been doing.

words.meaning: to be glad, delighted (to see someone)
words.example_en: I'm so glad we get to meet like this.
I've missed you a lot this whole time.

sentences.en: At last, I met my friend after a long time.
As soon as we met, we asked how each other had been.
Meeting again like this, I'm truly glad.

sentences.ko: 혼자 있을 때 네가 많이 그리웠다.
sentences.reading: hon-ja iss-eul ttae ne-ga man-i geu-ri-wot-da
sentences.en: When I was alone, I missed you a lot.

sentences.ko: 이 재회를 오래도록 기억할 것 같습니다.
sentences.reading: i jae-hoe-reul o-rae-do-rok gi-eok-hal geot gat-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: I think I'll remember this reunion for a long time.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.en: Tower, long time no see. Have you been well?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 응! 그동안 연락도 잘 못 해서 미안해. 너는 잘 지냈어?
turns.reading: eung! geu-dong-an yeol-lak-do jal mot hae-seo mi-an-hae. neo-neun jal ji-naess-eo?
turns.en: Yeah! Sorry I couldn't keep in touch much. Have you been doing okay?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 비행 스케줄 조정하느라 정신없었지만, 오늘만큼은 무조건 시간을 냈습니다.
turns.reading: bi-haeng seu-ke-jul jo-jeong-ha-neu-ra jeong-sin-eop-seot-ji-man, o-neul-man-keum-eun mu-jo-geon si-gan-eul naess-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: I was swamped rearranging my flight schedule, but today, no matter what, I made time.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 역시 상우답다. 이렇게까지 신경 써 줘서 고마워.
turns.reading: yeok-si sang-u-dab-da. i-reo-ke-kka-ji sin-gyeong sseo jwo-seo go-ma-wo.
turns.en: That's so like you, Sangwoo. Thanks for going to such trouble for me.

dialogues.question: 승객이 '역시 상우답다'라고 말한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What is the most fitting reason the passenger says, 'That's so like you, Sangwoo'?
dialogues.correct_answer: 상우가 바쁜 비행 스케줄을 조정하면서까지 재회를 위해 시간을 냈기 때문에
options: 상우가 바쁜 비행 스케줄을 조정하면서까지 재회를 위해 시간을 냈기 때문에
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 바쁜 비행 스케줄을 여러 번 조정하면서까지 친구와의 재회를 위해 시간을 냈고, 승객은 그런 상우의 마음 씀씀이에 고마움을 표현하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Wait, what's with the sudden 'Tower' thing?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 예전부터 붙인 네 별명입니다. 네 목소리를 들으면 늘 관제사처럼 든든했거든요.
turns.reading: ye-jeon-bu-teo but-in ne byeol-myeong-im-ni-da. ne mok-so-ri-reul deul-eu-myeon neul gwan-je-sa-cheo-reom deun-deun-haess-geo-deun-yo.
turns.en: It's a nickname I gave you a long time ago. Hearing your voice always felt as reassuring as a controller's.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 풋, 여전히 넌 어디서든 기장 모드구나.
turns.reading: put, yeo-jeon-hi neon eo-di-seo-deun gi-jang mo-deu-gu-na.
turns.en: Ha, you're still in captain mode wherever you go, huh.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 직업병입니다. 그래도 오늘은, 그냥 반가운 친구로 왔습니다.
turns.reading: jig-eop-byeong-im-ni-da. geu-rae-do o-neul-eun, geu-nyang ban-ga-un chin-gu-ro wat-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: Occupational habit. But today, I came simply as a glad-to-see-you friend.

dialogues.question: 상우가 승객을 '타워'라고 부르는 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sangwoo call the passenger 'Tower'?
dialogues.correct_answer: 친구의 목소리가 관제사처럼 든든하게 느껴져서 오래전 붙인 별명이기 때문에
options: 친구의 목소리가 관제사처럼 든든하게 느껴져서 오래전 붙인 별명이기 때문에
친구가 그 별명을 먼저 지어줬기 때문에
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 친구의 목소리에서 느꼈던 든든함을 관제사에 빗대어 '타워'라는 별명을 붙였고, 이는 오랜 우정에서 비롯된 애정 표현입니다.
